en: The Philippine flag's sun has exactly 8 rays, representing the first 8 provinces that revolted against Spain.
The Philippines has over 180 distinct languages, but only Filipino and English are its two official languages.
The Philippine Congress is bicameral, consisting of exactly 24 Senators and a House of Representatives with over 300 members.
Jose Rizal wrote his 2 famous anti-colonial novels, Noli Me Tangere and El Filibusterismo, before his execution at age 35.
Cebu's Sinulog Festival happens every 3rd Sunday of January, drawing millions of dancers and tourists to the streets.
If placed end to end, the Banaue Rice Terraces built by the Igorot people would stretch over 20,000 kilometers.
Dr. Fe del Mundo was the first Asian woman accepted to Harvard Medical School, graduating in 1940 at age 29.
The Philippines celebrated its independence centennial in 1998, exactly 100 years after Emilio Aguinaldo proclaimed it in Kawit.
The Philippine eagle, the national bird, stands about 1 meter tall and has a wingspan of up to 2 meters.
The 1987 Philippine Constitution contains exactly 18 articles, with Article 3 specifically detailing the citizen's Bill of Rights.
National Artist Napoleon Abueva created over 300 sculptures, including the famous Nine Muses at the University of the Philippines.
The Ifugao carve wooden bulul statues to guard their rice granaries, continuing a sacred tradition that began over 2,000 years ago.
